entries.title: At least 90 killed in Chinese coal mine explosion, state media reports
entries.snippet: The blast in Shanxi province constitutes the country's worst mining disaster in 16 years.

entries.title: Putin vows retaliation after accusing Ukraine of hitting student dormitory
entries.snippet: Ukraine says it struck Russia's elite Rubicon drone military unit in a Moscow-occupied region.

entries.title: SpaceX launches massive Starship V3 rocket on test flight
entries.snippet: The largest and most powerful rocket in history blasted off after its first attempted launch was postponed.

entries.title: Race for French presidency sees ex-PM Philippe as early favourite to beat populists
entries.snippet: Latest polls suggest the centre-right figure is the only candidate who can defeat Marine Le Pen or Jean-Luc Mélenchon.

entries.title: Rubio meets Modi during India visit with energy high on agenda
entries.snippet: The secretary of state wants to sell US energy to Delhi to make up for shortfalls caused by the Iran war.

entries.title: Senegal's president sacks PM and former ally after months-long feud
entries.snippet: Bassirou Diomaye Faye also dissolved the government, creating uncertainty amid a debt crisis in the country.

entries.title: Tulsi Gabbard to resign as US national intelligence director
entries.snippet: Gabbard who has been largely out of public view during recent US operations says she is leaving due to her husband's illness.

entries.title: Ebola risk raised to 'very high' in DR Congo
entries.snippet: The head of the UN health agency says the risk in the wider region is "high", but it remains "low" at the global level.

entries.title: Gaza flotilla activists allege abuse by Israeli forces while detained
entries.snippet: The detainees say they were slapped, hit, humiliated and even subjected to sexual violence, but Israel's prison service says the allegations are false.

entries.title: US government releases UFO sighting reports - 'Orbs swarming in all directions'
entries.snippet: The Pentagon discloses scores of UFO files with reported sightings of spheres, discs and fireballs spanning nearly 80 years.

entries.title: One dead and dozens of firefighters injured in Staten Island shipyard explosion
entries.snippet: More than 30 people, including firefighters, were hurt in the incident, which was described as "a complex, fast-developing emergency situation".

entries.title: Bodies of Italian divers did not have optimal equipment, says rescuer
entries.snippet: Images from a cave where the four Italians were found reveal the difficulty that rescuers had in recovering their bodies.

entries.title: Rubio tries to reassure Nato allies over US troop deployments
entries.snippet: President Donald Trump says he wants to send more troops to Poland, a week after his officials cancelled a similar deployment.

entries.title: More than 40,000 Californians evacuated due to chemical tank leak
entries.snippet: Officials warn the tank contains a "highly volatile" substance that could lead to an explosion.

entries.title: Carney says Alberta is 'essential' to Canada as province plans vote on separation
entries.snippet: Alberta's decision to hold a referendum on separation has been widely criticised, including by separatists who say the question is not definitive enough.

entries.title: Judge dismisses criminal case against Kilmar Abrego Garcia
entries.snippet: A federal judge says the Maryland man who was wrongfully deported last year is being prosecuted for political reasons.

entries.title: Sabalenka cuts media short as French Open players protest
entries.snippet: Leading players, including Aryna Sabalenka, Coco Gauff and Jannik Sinner, limit their French Open media duties to 15 minutes in a row over prize money.

entries.title: Waymo pauses robotaxis in five US cities after cars drive into flooded roads
entries.snippet: A Waymo spokesperson said it had expanded the temporary pause "out of an abundance of caution".

entries.title: 'Speed, money and compassion' - lessons from an Ebola survivor and other experts
entries.snippet: Those caught up in West Africa's Ebola outbreak a decade ago on how best to tackle the current epidemic.

entries.title: The space race to create gym equipment for future astronauts
entries.snippet: Scientists are attempting to build exercise equipment to be used on future space flights.

entries.title: U.S. passengers flying from Ebola-affected countries rerouted
entries.snippet: The U.S. government is responding to the Ebola outbreak in with travel restrictions. American citizens and permanent residents departing affected countries must fly into one of three U.S. airports.

entries.title: Opinion: Remembering Barney Frank, trailblazing public servant
entries.snippet: Mass. congressman Barney Frank was the first House member to come out as gay and was instrumental in Wall Street reforms after the Great Recession. He died this week at the age of 86.

entries.title: Chile's MAGA-inspired border control
entries.snippet: Chile digs desert trenches along its northern border as President José Antonio Kast pushes a hardline migration crackdown critics say may have little effect.

entries.title: Summer electric bills sizzle as the cost of cooling climbs
entries.snippet: The temperature is climbing, and so are people's utility bills. Rising electricity prices and hotter-than-usual weather could make it especially costly to stay cool this summer.

entries.title: One solution for Maine's struggling fishing industry? Give fillets away for free
entries.snippet: Surging food costs and fuel prices are pummeling Maine's struggling groundfishing industry. But a pandemic-era program is helping to keep it afloat as inflation worsens.

entries.title: 15 years since a deadly tornado brought Joplin, Mo. together, kindness carries on
entries.snippet: Nearly 100,000 volunteers helped the town rebuild and a spirit of community service continues to this day. Researchers studying human behavior catastrophes can bring out compassion in surprising ways.

entries.title: 'I'd wait forever, but 334 days is crazy.' USS Ford finally comes home
entries.snippet: The USS Ford came home to a hero's welcome. Sailors had been away from home for nearly a year, through two conflicts, a fire and problems with the sewage system.

entries.title: Coal mine gas explosion in China kills 90 people, state media say
entries.snippet: A gas explosion at a coal mine in China's northern province of Shanxi killed at least 90 people. Official news agency Xinhua said the accident happened on Friday evening. Around 247 workers were on duty at the time.

entries.title: SpaceX launches its biggest, most beefed-up Starship yet on a test flight
entries.snippet: The mega rocket made its debut two days after SpaceX CEO Elon Musk announced he's taking the company public. NASA Administrator Jared Isaacman said Starship is now one step closer to the moon.

entries.title: Trump administration to force foreigners in the U.S. to apply for a green card abroad
entries.snippet: Foreigners in the U.S. who want a green card will need to leave and apply in their home country, the Trump administration announced Friday, in a surprise change to a longstanding policy.

entries.title: Is it time for the U.S. to reassess its Iran strategy?
entries.snippet: With talks stalled and Iran maintaining its chokehold over the Strait of Hormuz, President Trump is weighing whether to restart the war. Strikes failed to eliminate Iran's regime or destroy its military and nuclear capabilities, so is it time for the U.S. to reassess its strategy

entries.snippet: Director of National Intelligence Tulsi Gabbard, the highest-ranking intelligence official in the U.S. government, has resigned. She said her husband is suffering from a rare bone cancer that requires her full attention. Nick Schifrin and Liz Landers report, and William Brangham

entries.title: SpaceX launches its biggest Starship mega rocket yet on test flight
entries.snippet: It's the 12th test flight of the rocket that SpaceX is building to get people to Mars one day. But first comes the moon and NASA's Artemis program.

entries.title: News Wrap: Rubio meets with NATO allies amid troop level confusion

entries.title: Trump's Cuba strategy echoes his Venezuela playbook, but experts point out key differences
entries.snippet: Similar pressure campaigns do not equal similar results, experts say, even if President Donald Trump has often warned that "Cuba is next."

entries.title: What's behind the decade-long 'learning recession' for American students
entries.snippet: As the school year is coming to a close, a new analysis shines another harsh spotlight on what's being called a "learning recession" for American students. It's a problem that started long before the pandemic, according to the latest National Education Scorecard. William Brangham

entries.title: Shein's purchase of sustainable fashion brand Everlane sparks outcry
entries.snippet: A deal between two seemingly incompatible clothing brands is causing a lot of consternation among customers and raising questions about sustainable fashion. Shein, the Chinese fast-fashion giant, is acquiring Everlane. For many, Everlane has been the face of a sustainable and eth

entries.title: Shipyard fire and explosion on Staten Island injures at least 16, officials say
entries.snippet: Someone reported two workers trapped in a confined space at the dock at about 3:30 p.m. Friday, and responding firefighters found a fire burning in the basement of a large metal structure at the dock, said Joanne Mariano with the New York Fire Department's press office.

entries.title: Carbon credit program pays small landowners to keep forests standing

entries.snippet: David Brooks of The Atlantic and Jonathan Capehart of MS NOW join William Brangham to discuss the week in politics, including President Trump demonstrating his grip on Republican primary voters, another Cabinet member departs his administration and Democrats releasing a clumsy an

entries.title: NASCAR's Kyle Busch was short of breath, coughing up blood a day before death, 911 call reveals
entries.snippet: Busch died Thursday at age 41. No cause of death has been given, though his family said earlier he had been hospitalized with a "severe illness" three days before he was to compete in the Coca-Cola 600 at Charlotte Motor Speedway.

entries.title: FDA move allowing more e-cigarettes and nicotine pouches into U.S. blindsides officials
entries.snippet: Senior officials in the Food and Drug Administration's tobacco center were blindsided by a recent decision that opens the door to allowing more unauthorized electronic cigarettes and nicotine pouches onto the U.S. market, The Associated Press has learned.

entries.title: Foreigners in U.S. must apply for green cards abroad, new Trump administration rule says
entries.snippet: The announcement from U.S. Citizenship and Immigration Services is the latest step by the Trump administration making legal immigration more difficult for foreigners already in the U.S. and for those hoping to come here.

entries.title: Former Epstein assistant Sarah Kellen testified before the House committee. Here's what we know
entries.snippet: Sarah Kellen, a former personal assistant to Jeffrey Epstein, testified Thursday in a closed-door deposition on her yearslong connection to the convicted sex offender, saying she was a target of his abuse as she managed logistics of his relations with girls and young women.

entries.title: Federal judge dismisses human smuggling charges against Kilmar Abrego Garcia
entries.snippet: A federal judge on Friday dismissed a human smuggling case against Kilmar Abrego Garcia, finding that the Justice Department's pursuit of criminal charges was designed to punish him for challenging his mistaken deportation to El Salvador last year.

entries.title: WATCH: Trump speaks at N.Y.'s Rockland Community College, campaigning for Rep. Lawler
entries.snippet: President Donald Trump, from a toss-up congressional district in New York on Friday, began testing his midterm-year message that was ostensibly on the economy. But he veered off-topic right from the start, going off on tangents about voter identification, crime in cities, transge

entries.title: What to know about the Hajj, Eid al-Adha and their significance to Muslims around the world
entries.snippet: Once a year, large numbers of Muslim pilgrims converge in Saudi Arabia, uniting in religious rituals and acts of worship as they perform the Hajj.

entries.title: All-women Senate delegation heads to the Arctic to reassure U.S. allies in the region
entries.snippet: Seeking to reassure U.S. allies, a bipartisan group of senators is departing for a tour of Arctic nations. And this time they're leaving the men behind.

entries.title: Read Tulsi Gabbard's full resignation letter as director of national intelligence
entries.snippet: During her 15 months as chief of America's spy agencies, Gabbard faced scrutiny over her conduct and the handling of U.S. intelligence.

entries.title: Tulsi Gabbard resigns as Trump's national intelligence director
entries.snippet: Tulsi Gabbard resigned as President Donald Trump's director of national intelligence on Friday, saying she needed to step away as her husband battles cancer. She is the fourth Cabinet official to depart during Trump's second term.

entries.title: DW
entries.snippet: News, Analysis and Service from Germany and Europe - in 30 Languages

entries.title: Thailand revives bill to clear the air of toxic smog
entries.snippet: Seasonal smog is a major public health problem in Thailand. Long-delayed legislation aims to stop air pollution before it starts, but enforcement could present a problem.

entries.title: Ukrainian strike in Russian-controlled area leaves 10 dead
entries.snippet: Russian authorities in Luhansk said a Ukrainian drone hit a university dorm, wounding dozens and killing 10. Vladimir Putin has condemned the drone barrage and ordered the army to prepare a response.

entries.title: Germany news: Germany marks Constitution Day
entries.snippet: Germany is commemorating the day its Basic Law came into effect 77 years ago. And a record number of German passports were issued in 2025, media report. DW has more.

entries.title: South Africa xenophobia response under fire
entries.snippet: South Africa condemns xenophobic violence when it erupts, but critics say prevention is weak, arrests are limited and political rhetoric sometimes fuels tensions instead of easing them.

entries.title: Germany: Record numbers take German passport in 2025
entries.snippet: A record number of people received a German passport in 2025, a media report says. Numbers have been rising since Germany changed citizenship requirements in 2024.

entries.title: Can the Quad stay relevant to boost Indo-Pacific security?
entries.snippet: Foreign ministers from the US, India, Japan and Australia — collectively known as the Quad — need to put past differences behind them if the alliance is to remain an effective means of countering China.

entries.title: India news: Marco Rubio visits to repair ties, boost QUAD
entries.snippet: US Secretary of State Rubio is in India to reset bilateral relations and strengthen the Quad grouping — an Indo-Pacific strategic alliance which includes India, the US, Japan and Australia. Follow DW for more.

entries.title: Czechia: Uproar over Sudeten German gathering in Brno
entries.snippet: The first gathering of Sudeten Germans in Czechia since World War II is set to go ahead this weekend, despite a political backlash that has exposed tensions over one of Central Europe's most painful historical legacies.

entries.title: Germany's 'rapid militarization' threatens basic rights
entries.snippet: Ten human rights organizations say security interests are increasingly being prioritized over fundamental rights in Germany. The scathing criticism was presented in their "2026 Fundamental Rights Report."

entries.title: US tells green card seekers to apply from abroad
entries.snippet: Under the new rule, green cards will be issued in applicants' home countries, though it remains unclear who all will be affected.

entries.title: China: Dozens dead in coal mine blast — state media
entries.snippet: An explosion in a coal mine in northern China has killed at least 82 people, with some still unaccounted for, state media say. President Xi Jinping has demanded an "all-out" effort to search for and rescue those missing.

entries.title: SpaceX launches biggest Starship rocket yet in test flight
entries.snippet: SpaceX's 12th Starship test flight took place just two days after Elon Musk announced that he was taking the company public.

entries.title: EU, Mexico sign expanded trade deal
entries.snippet: The updated accord between the European Union and Mexico removes most remaining barriers to trade and investment. President Sheinbaum said Mexico's respective trade deals with the EU and the US were "not contradictory."

entries.title: Kevin Warsh: Trump ally at the Federal Reserve?
entries.snippet: Never before has a chair of the US Federal Reserve been so controversial. Who is Kevin Warsh? Can he preserve the Fed's independence, or will he become Donald Trump's puppet?

entries.title: New alliances emerge in Middle East — which one will 'win'?
entries.snippet: The UAE and Israel are getting closer, while Saudi Arabia is enhancing cooperation with Egypt, Turkey and Pakistan. The new alliances represent a rift in the Gulf, as approaches to the Iran war and the region diverge.

entries.title: US or Iran: Who will win the Hormuz endurance game?
entries.snippet: Tehran is betting that its sanctions‑hardened economy can outlast the Strait of Hormuz crisis. Washington, meanwhile, is contending with elevated oil prices, renewed inflation pressure and rising global recession risks.

entries.title: US: Tulsi Gabbard resigns as Trump's intelligence chief
entries.snippet: Tulsi Gabbard has resigned as head of US intelligence, citing her husband's recent cancer diagnosis. An opponent of foreign US interventions, Gabbard has sought to distance herself from the US-Israeli war on Iran.

entries.title: US bourbon bets big on India's growing market
entries.snippet: Bourbon, the uniquely US take on whiskey, is facing its most serious inventory crisis in decades. The industry is increasingly looking to India to boost sales.

entries.title: The dying dream of the dead to be at peace with life
entries.snippet: Many people have vivid dreams shortly before death. Research suggests the dreams are not a sign of confusion — but may help both the dying and their loved ones make sense of loss.
